It then cuts to scenes labeled 'JD Vance last week:' showing Vance, Donald Trump, and Volodymyr Zelenskyy in an office setting. In these scenes, on-screen text attributes confrontational quotes to a 'Trump ally' and to Vance himself, and also shows Vance laughing.
